name: Recruitee
description: Recruitee applicant tracking: jobs (offers) and talent pools, candidates and full search, pipelines and stages, placements, notes, tags, departments, locations, interviews and evaluations, tasks and activity. Recruitee ATS API with a personal API token.
prerequisites: A Recruitee user whose role covers the jobs and candidates the agent should see; the token acts as that user.

RECRUITEE_COMPANY_ID.label: Company ID
RECRUITEE_COMPANY_ID.help: Recruitee, Settings > Apps and plugins > Personal API tokens: the company ID shown on that page (a number). The company subdomain also works.
RECRUITEE_COMPANY_ID.patternMessage: Enter only the company ID (e.g. 123456) or subdomain, not a URL.

RECRUITEE_API_TOKEN.label: Personal API token
RECRUITEE_API_TOKEN.help: Recruitee, Settings > Apps and plugins > Personal API tokens > Add new token. The token belongs to one company and acts with your role.
RECRUITEE_API_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste only the token, without Bearer, spaces or quotes.

verifyHints.401: Recruitee refused the token (Token not found). Create a new personal API token in the same company; tokens are per company and cannot be shown again.
verifyHints.403: The token's user role cannot do this. Use a token of a user with access to the jobs and candidates involved.
verifyHints.404: Unknown company ID or record. Copy the company ID from the Personal API tokens page.

instructions:
## Recruitee
This connector reads and updates **Recruitee** (Tellent Recruitee), an applicant tracking system, through its ATS API (`https://api.recruitee.com/c/<company id>`): jobs and talent pools, candidates, pipelines and stages, notes, tags, departments, locations, interviews and evaluations, tasks and the activity feed.

**Personal data**: candidates are applicants with CVs, contact details, evaluations and sometimes date of birth or nationality. Read only what the task needs and respect the company's GDPR settings; do not copy candidate data into other tools without a reason.

**Setup (3 minutes)**
1. In Recruitee open **Settings > Apps and plugins > Personal API tokens** (`https://app.recruitee.com/#/settings/api_tokens`), click **Add new token**, give it a label and confirm your password. Copy the token into `RECRUITEE_API_TOKEN`.
2. Copy the **company ID** shown on the same page into `RECRUITEE_COMPANY_ID`.
3. The token acts as you, with your role, in that one company only (another company needs its own token). Recruitee cannot narrow its scope, so create it with a user whose role fits what the agent should do. `recruitee_get_current_admin` is the install check.

**Words**: a job is an *offer* (`kind` job; a talent pool is an offer of `kind` talent_pool). A candidate in a job is a *placement*: it carries the stage and the disqualification for that job. Team members are *admins*.

**Workflow**
- Team: `recruitee_get_current_admin`, `recruitee_list_admins` (ids for task assignees and filters).
- Jobs: `recruitee_list_offers` (filter by `statuses` such as published), `recruitee_get_offer` (description and the pipeline stages with their ids), `recruitee_list_offer_notes`. Create and manage: `recruitee_create_offer` (draft), `recruitee_update_offer`, `recruitee_publish_offer`, `recruitee_unpublish_offer`, `recruitee_close_offer`.
- Candidates: `recruitee_list_candidates` (simple filters), `recruitee_search_candidates` (full search with `filters_json`), `recruitee_get_candidate` (profile and placements), `recruitee_list_candidate_notes`, `recruitee_list_candidate_tasks`, `recruitee_list_candidate_activities`. Company-wide feed: `recruitee_list_activities`.
- Pipeline of a job: `recruitee_list_placements` (who is in which stage), `recruitee_list_pipeline_templates`, `recruitee_get_pipeline_template`, `recruitee_list_disqualify_reasons`.
- Moving candidates: `recruitee_assign_candidate` (into a job or talent pool), `recruitee_change_stage` (placement id and stage id from `recruitee_get_offer`), `recruitee_disqualify_candidate` and `recruitee_requalify_candidate`.
- Adding and enriching candidates: `recruitee_create_candidate` (optionally applied to jobs; a `remote_cv_url` is parsed), `recruitee_update_candidate`, `recruitee_add_candidate_tags`, `recruitee_remove_candidate_tags`, `recruitee_add_candidate_field`, `recruitee_create_candidate_note`.
- Reference lists: `recruitee_list_departments`, `recruitee_get_department`, `recruitee_list_locations`, `recruitee_get_location`, `recruitee_list_tags`, `recruitee_list_sources`.
- Interviews: `recruitee_list_interview_events` (upcoming by default), `recruitee_get_interview_event`, `recruitee_list_interview_results` (evaluations and scorecards).
- Tasks: `recruitee_list_tasks`, `recruitee_create_task`, `recruitee_complete_task`.

**Switched off at install**: `recruitee_delete_candidate` and `recruitee_remove_placement`; they cannot be undone, so an admin switches them on when the team needs them.

**Automations**: creating a candidate on a job, changing a stage with `run_actions` true, or disqualifying can trigger emails and actions the company configured in Recruitee. Say so before doing it for many candidates.

**Search filters** (`recruitee_search_candidates`): `filters_json` is a JSON array as a string, e.g. `[{"field":"all","query":"java"},{"filter":"tags","id":{"in":[12]}},{"field":"created_at","gte":"2026-10-01"}]`. Text: `field` all; status and source: `{"field":"status","in":["qualified"]}`; stages: `{"filter":"stages","name":{"in":[...]}}`.

**Reading the answers**
- Ids are integers. Dates and times are ISO 8601 in UTC (`2026-10-19T11:02:32Z`).
- A candidate's `placements` list one entry per job with `offer_id`, `stage_id` and `disqualify_reason`; use the placement `id` for stage and qualification changes.
- `adminapp_url` links to the candidate in Recruitee.

**Paging**: `recruitee_list_candidates` pages with `limit` (max 1000) and `offset`; offers, search, locations, activities, events and tasks page with `limit` and `page` (from 1). Stop when a page returns fewer items than `limit`.

**Errors**: 401 `invalid_token` means a wrong, revoked or other company's token; 403 a role without the right; 404 a wrong company ID or record id; 422 a validation error with the field named in the body.

tools.name: recruitee_get_current_admin
tools.description: The team member (admin) the token belongs to: id, name, email, role and time zone. The install check.

tools.name: recruitee_list_admins
tools.description: Team members (admins) of the company with id, name, email and role; ids are used for task assignees, interview participants and followers.

authorized_for_candidate_id.description: Only team members who can access this candidate.

tools.name: recruitee_list_offers
tools.description: Jobs and talent pools (Recruitee calls them offers): id, title, status, kind, department, locations, recruiter, candidate counts, pipeline and careers site URL.

statuses.description: draft, published, internal, closed, archived. Omit for all.

kind.description: job or talent_pool. Omit for both.

recruiter_ids.description: Only offers with these recruiter admin ids.

hiring_manager_ids.description: Only offers with these hiring manager admin ids.

include.description: Extra parts: description, requirements, highlight, work_models, salary, dynamic_fields, follower_ids, location_ids, requisition_ids, tags, counters.

tools.name: recruitee_get_offer
tools.description: One job or talent pool by id with description, requirements, locations, department, hiring team and its pipeline stages (ids used to move candidates).

tools.name: recruitee_list_offer_notes
tools.description: Internal team notes on a job (offer), with author, text and time of each note.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidates
tools.description: List candidates with name, emails, phones, source, tags, rating, placements (job, stage, disqualified) and creation date. Contains personal data.

query.description: Search the candidate's name or job.

created_after.description: Only candidates created after this date, YYYY-MM-DD.

offset.description: Results to skip: previous offset plus limit.

tools.name: recruitee_search_candidates
tools.description: Full candidate search across the database with filters on text, tags, sources, stages, ratings, dates, custom fields, education and experience.

filters_json.description: Filters as a JSON array string, e.g. [{"field":"all","query":"python developer"}] for full text, [{"filter":"tags","id":{"in":[12]}}] for tags, [{"field":"created_at","gte":"2026-10-01"}] for dates. Combine several objects in the array.

sort_by.description: Field and direction, e.g. created_at_desc (default), relevance_desc, candidate_name_asc, last_activity_at_desc, candidate_rating_desc.

tools.name: recruitee_get_candidate
tools.description: One candidate by id: contact details, CV and cover letter links, sources, tags, custom fields, ratings, placements (job, stage, disqualification) and open question answers.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidate_notes
tools.description: Team notes on a candidate with author, text, pinned flag and time of each note.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidate_activities
tools.description: Activity history of a candidate: applications, stage moves, emails, notes, evaluations and events, newest first.

tools.name: recruitee_list_activities
tools.description: Company-wide activity feed (applications, stage changes, notes, emails, evaluations), filterable by candidates, offers, event names and dates.

tools.name: recruitee_list_placements
tools.description: Candidates in a job's pipeline (placements): placement id, candidate, stage, disqualification, rating, upcoming event and overdue date.

tools.name: recruitee_list_pipeline_templates
tools.description: Pipeline templates with their stages (id, name, category such as apply, interview, offer, hire).

tools.name: recruitee_get_pipeline_template
tools.description: One pipeline template with all its stages in order (stage id, name and category).

tools.name: recruitee_list_disqualify_reasons
tools.description: Reasons a candidate can be disqualified with (id and name), for recruitee_disqualify_candidate.

tools.name: recruitee_list_departments
tools.description: Departments of the company with id, name and offer counts, to filter or create jobs.

tools.name: recruitee_get_department
tools.description: One department by id with its name and translations, to resolve the department_id of a job.

tools.name: recruitee_list_locations
tools.description: Job locations with id, name, address, city, country and active flag.

view_mode.description: brief (default) or full with translations and offer counters.

tools.name: recruitee_get_location
tools.description: One job location by id with its full address, translations and active flag.

tools.name: recruitee_list_tags
tools.description: Candidate tags of the company with id, name and how many candidates carry them.

tools.name: recruitee_list_sources
tools.description: Candidate sources (where applicants came from) with id and name.

tools.name: recruitee_list_interview_events
tools.description: Scheduled interviews and other events: candidate, job, participants, start and end, location or video link, status.

admin_ids.description: Only events of these team members.

timezone.description: Time zone of the range, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam.

tools.name: recruitee_get_interview_event
tools.description: One interview event with participants, times, location and the candidate.

tools.name: recruitee_list_interview_results
tools.description: Evaluations and scorecards written about candidates, with reviewer, rating and answers.

admin_ids.description: Only results by these team members.

tools.name: recruitee_list_tasks
tools.description: Recruiting tasks of the company: title, description, candidate, assignees, due date and completion.

admin_ids.description: Only tasks of these team members.

tools.name: recruitee_list_candidate_tasks
tools.description: Tasks linked to one candidate with assignees, due date and completion.

tools.name: recruitee_create_candidate
tools.description: Add a candidate, optionally applied to jobs. Recruitee may send automatic emails configured for the job.

remote_cv_url.description: Public URL of the CV file; Recruitee downloads and parses it.

offers.description: Offer ids to apply the candidate to (first stage). Omit to add without a job.

tools.name: recruitee_update_candidate
tools.description: Change a candidate's profile: name, emails, phones, links, cover letter or sources. Only the fields sent change.

tools.name: recruitee_delete_candidate
tools.description: Delete a candidate with all their data. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

tools.name: recruitee_add_candidate_tags
tools.description: Add tags to a candidate by name; tag names that do not exist yet are created.

tools.name: recruitee_remove_candidate_tags
tools.description: Remove tags from a candidate (the tags stay in the company list).

tools.name: recruitee_add_candidate_field
tools.description: Add a profile field to a candidate, e.g. skills, languages, nationality or a single-line value.

name.description: Field name (for single_line, multi_line and boolean).

values.description: Values, e.g. [{"text":"Python"}] for skills or single_line, [{"flag":true}] for boolean, [{"language_code":"de","level":"fluent"}] for language_skill, [{"country_code":"NL"}] for nationality, [{"date":"1990-04-01"}] for date_of_birth.

tools.name: recruitee_create_candidate_note
tools.description: Write a team note on a candidate's profile (visible to the hiring team, not to the candidate).

tools.name: recruitee_assign_candidate
tools.description: Put an existing candidate into a job's pipeline (first stage) or a talent pool. Returns the placement.

offer_id.description: Offer (job) id. Give this or talent_pool_id.

location_ids.description: Location ids of the job the candidate applies for.

tools.name: recruitee_change_stage
tools.description: Move a candidate's placement to another pipeline stage. Moving to a hired stage can need hired_at, work_location_id and, with requisitions, opening_id.

proceed.description: true places the candidate at the top of the stage.

hired_at.description: Hire date-time, ISO 8601, for a hired stage.

work_location_id.description: Work location id, needed when hiring.

opening_id.description: Requisition opening id, needed when hiring with requisitions.

run_actions.description: true runs the stage's automated actions (e.g. emails).

tools.name: recruitee_disqualify_candidate
tools.description: Disqualify a candidate in one job (placement) with a reason. Reversible with recruitee_requalify_candidate.

tools.name: recruitee_requalify_candidate
tools.description: Requalify a disqualified candidate in one job (placement), back into the pipeline.

tools.name: recruitee_remove_placement
tools.description: Remove a candidate from a job's pipeline, with that placement's stage history. Cannot be undone; switched off at install.

tools.name: recruitee_create_offer
tools.description: Create a job (or talent pool) as a draft; publish it with recruitee_publish_offer.

tools.name: recruitee_update_offer
tools.description: Change a job's fields, e.g. title, description, requirements, department, locations or salary. Only the fields sent change.

tools.name: recruitee_publish_offer
tools.description: Publish a job on the careers site and job boards set up for it.

tools.name: recruitee_unpublish_offer
tools.description: Unpublish a job: it leaves the careers site but keeps its candidates.

tools.name: recruitee_close_offer
tools.description: Close a job: no new applications, candidates stay in the pipeline.

tools.name: recruitee_create_task
tools.description: Create a recruiting task for team members, optionally linked to a candidate and with a due date.

admin_ids.description: Assignee team member ids from recruitee_list_admins.

timezone.description: Time zone of the due date, e.g. Europe/Amsterdam (required with due_date).

tools.name: recruitee_complete_task
tools.description: Mark a task as completed, or reopen it with completed false.
